subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · 1re · Grammaire · Hypothèses et nuances
description: Règles et automatismes — hypothèses et nuances.

cards.front: Complète : If I ___ more time, I ___ abroad. (have/travel)
cards.back: If I had more time, I would travel abroad.

cards.front: Traduis : « J'aimerais avoir plus de temps. »
cards.back: I wish I had more time.

cards.front: Traduis : « J'aimerais savoir mieux parler anglais. »
cards.back: I wish I could speak English better.

cards.front: Traduis : « Il se pourrait qu'elle ait raison. »
cards.back: She might be right.

cards.front: Traduis : « Il a dû oublier. »
cards.back: He must have forgotten.

cards.front: Traduis : « Elle ne peut pas avoir écrit cela. »
cards.back: She can't have written that.

cards.front: Reformule avec despite : Although it was difficult, they succeeded.
cards.back: Despite the difficulty, they succeeded.

cards.front: Relie : One source is optimistic. The other is critical.
cards.back: One source is optimistic, whereas the other is critical.

cards.front: Réduis : Because she was inspired, she took action.
cards.back: Inspired, she took action.

cards.front: Atténue l'affirmation : This proves that…
cards.back: This suggests that… / This may indicate that…
